titleEn: Minimum Time to Finish the Race
title: 完成比赛的最少时间
summary: 轮胎连续使用时单圈时间按倍率增长，换胎固定耗时，求完成 numLaps 圈的最短时间。
insight: 预处理不换胎连续跑若干圈的最小累计时间；当下一圈时间已不如换胎后用最快首圈时即可停止延伸。随后按圈数做完全分段 DP，每段对应一套连续使用的轮胎。
pitfalls: 第一套轮胎不支付换胎时间
每种胎连续圈数很快受指数增长限制
中间累计使用 long 防溢出

solutions.title: 连续赛段预处理与圈数 DP
solutions.idea: 把比赛拆成若干不换胎赛段。
steps: fastestFirst=min f；best[run] 初始化无穷，对每种胎累计连续圈耗时并更新，下一圈超过 fastestFirst+changeTime 时停止
laps 从一到 numLaps，枚举 run<=laps 且 best 有效，dp[laps]=min(dp[laps-run]+changeTime+best[run])

code.java: class Solution { public int minimumFinishTime(int[][] tires,int changeTime,int numLaps){long infinity=Long.MAX_VALUE/4;long[] best=new long[numLaps+1];Arrays.fill(best,infinity);int fastest=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int[] tire:tires)fastest=Math.min(fastest,tire[0]);for(int[] tire:tires){long lap=tire[0],total=0;for(int run=1;run<=numLaps&&lap<=fastest+changeTime;run++){total+=lap;best[run]=Math.min(best[run],total);if(lap>infinity/tire[1])break;lap*=tire[1];}}long[] dp=new long[numLaps+1];Arrays.fill(dp,infinity);dp[0]=-changeTime;for(int laps=1;laps<=numLaps;laps++)for(int run=1;run<=laps&&best[run]<infinity;run++)dp[laps]=Math.min(dp[laps],dp[laps-run]+changeTime+best[run]);return (int)dp[numLaps];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumFinishTime(tires:Array<IntArray>,changeTime:Int,numLaps:Int):Int{val infinity=Long.MAX_VALUE/4;val best=LongArray(numLaps+1){infinity};val fastest=tires.minOf{it[0]};for(tire in tires){var lap=tire[0].toLong();var total=0L;var run=1;while(run<=numLaps&&lap<=fastest+changeTime){total+=lap;best[run]=minOf(best[run],total);if(lap>infinity/tire[1])break;lap*=tire[1];run++}};val dp=LongArray(numLaps+1){infinity};dp[0]=-changeTime.toLong();for(laps in 1..numLaps)for(run in 1..laps)if(best[run]<infinity)dp[laps]=minOf(dp[laps],dp[laps-run]+changeTime+best[run]);return dp[numLaps].toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int minimumFinishTime(vector<vector<int>>& tires,int changeTime,int numLaps){const long long infinity=LLONG_MAX/4;vector<long long> best(numLaps+1,infinity);int fastest=INT_MAX;for(auto& tire:tires)fastest=min(fastest,tire[0]);for(auto& tire:tires){long long lap=tire[0],total=0;for(int run=1;run<=numLaps&&lap<=fastest+changeTime;++run){total+=lap;best[run]=min(best[run],total);if(lap>infinity/tire[1])break;lap*=tire[1];}}vector<long long> dp(numLaps+1,infinity);dp[0]=-changeTime;for(int laps=1;laps<=numLaps;++laps)for(int run=1;run<=laps&&best[run]<infinity;++run)dp[laps]=min(dp[laps],dp[laps-run]+changeTime+best[run]);return dp[numLaps];} };
